counter_search.approach: Expand directly sampled on-curve points and add coordinate-aware mutations of standard generators. Recover y from the curve equation, retain only canonical points classified outside the subgroup by ordinary [r]P, and submit the exact encodings to Bor's production pairing Run.
counter_search.result: All 370 expanded on-curve off-subgroup inputs were decoder-accepted and rejected by production Run with the corresponding G1 or G2 subgroup error. The original two off-subgroup points were also rejected.

set_and_tuple_analysis.tuple_probes: Production Run returned subgroup errors for G1 and G2 off-subgroup tuples both before and after a valid tuple, and when both invalid group points shared one tuple. The valid finite single pair returned without error with a 32-byte zero result; acceptance and pairing result are reported separately.

economic_witness.reason: The prerequisite false pairing acceptance was not established. The expanded search preserved the same rejection at production subgroup validation, so an escrow execution would not exercise a false pairing acceptance.

conclusion: No credible false pairing acceptance was demonstrated. Across the original corpus, 370 additional on-curve off-subgroup inputs, 91 valid-subgroup pairing-product cases totaling 5,032 tuples, 24 metamorphic backend relations, and five amd64 build variants on one host, no false acceptance, output difference, backend disagreement, or violated algebraic relation was found. Batch 6 remains gated; this is evidence about the tested inputs and host, not a proof over every possible input or architecture. No economic vulnerability conclusion is made.
